typologies.label: Over and under invoicing of goods
typologies.summary: Misrepresenting the price of goods on trade documents to move value across borders.
indicators: Unit price materially outside market range
Same goods repeatedly re-invoiced between related parties

typologies.label: Phantom shipments
typologies.summary: Payment for goods that were never shipped, supported by fabricated shipping documents.
indicators: Bill of lading not reconcilable to vessel movement

typologies.label: Sanctions evasion via front companies
typologies.summary: Designated persons transact through newly formed entities with opaque ownership in third countries.
indicators: Entity incorporated within 90 days of a designation
Shared directors with a designated party

typologies.label: Shadow fleet maritime evasion
typologies.summary: Vessels disable AIS, change flags and conduct ship-to-ship transfers to move sanctioned cargo.
indicators: AIS dark periods near known transfer zones

typologies.label: Nested correspondent relationships
typologies.summary: A respondent bank offers its correspondent access to third banks without the correspondent's knowledge.
indicators: Payment volumes inconsistent with respondent's stated customer base
Repeated originator fields naming other financial institutions

typologies.label: Mirror trading
typologies.summary: Matched buy and sell orders in different currencies used to move value offshore.
indicators: Same security bought and sold same day by linked accounts
No economic rationale for the trade pair

typologies.label: Money mule herding
typologies.summary: Coordinated recruitment of individuals whose accounts receive and forward illicit funds.
indicators: Many unrelated accounts sharing device or address

typologies.label: Chain hopping through unhosted wallets
typologies.summary: Converting between assets and chains to break the audit trail before cashing out at an exchange.
indicators: Exposure to mixer or bridge addresses
